scope: 2025 CCPC Harbin A B G I J L M
limitations: Small-case mathematical/algorithm checks; no online judge submission or extreme-scale performance validation.

A.method: all arrays of length<=4 over 1..5; enumerate distinct repeated-choice sums for k<=6

B.method: floating event simulation/static folding versus exact rational collision simulation

G.method: row suffix-minimum greedy versus independent maximum-flow supply/deficit matching, exhaustive 2x2 and random grids

I.method: all 512 patterns in a 3x3 axial window; GF(2) span of actual six-neighbor flips versus three coordinate parities

L.method: all masks of random obstacle layouts; grid BFS versus independent per-column interval DP

J.method: every ovw string through length9: full Manacher and constant-time boundary adjustment versus all original substrings

M.method: all direction assignments through n3 against explicit vertex triples and directed cycles, plus random n<=24 triple enumeration versus suffix sums and actual NTT
